title: Story premise ENT093: The Shopping List Origami
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (everyday microdramas). Hook: I made the list portable and the words inaccessible. Takeaway/theme: Compression is useful only if the information stays accessible.
description: A shopper wants to remember three ordinary items, but their overfolded paper list has hidden each word behind another crease. They unfold it into an absurdly large paper shape, copy the three items onto one small clear card, and use the original as a bag-shaped prop for the walk home.
